subject: Spectral energy distance TTS — kickoff
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kickoff for the spectral energy distance TTS workstream. The method trains highly parallel speech models without an analytical likelihood: a generalized energy distance over magnitude-spectrogram distributions, a proper scoring rule that can be estimated without bias from minibatches, with a repulsive term over multi-scale spectrogram distances. Our release hit MOS 4.25 — competitive with autoregressive systems that need tens of thousands of sequential ops per second of generated audio.

Product goal: low-latency TTS on our serving hardware, where autoregressive sampling is the cost driver today. Milestones: training repro by Apr 24, internal-voice dataset run by Jun 12, production-scale training in July, MOS panel late July.

Kaia, Jorge, Gustavo and Chiara assigned.

Goran
